title: Encrypt stored card numbers
author: benchmark
note: Key correctly from env (not a secret finding), but ECB mode for card data.

changed_files.diff:
+from Crypto.Cipher import AES
+import os
+
+KEY = os.environ["CARD_VAULT_KEY"].encode()
+
+def encrypt_pan(pan):
+    cipher = AES.new(KEY, AES.MODE_ECB)
+    padded = pan.ljust(32).encode()
+    return cipher.encrypt(padded)
